name: The Senior
source:
A continuation of The Junior, following the MC from that series as she enters her last year of college and looks on towards the future.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Senior]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
本作延續《The Junior》的故事，講述該系列女主角步入大學最後一年、展望未來的經歷。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Senior]Choices Wikia[/url]]
